name: cli-node
author: marlon-chaviano
title: Command-line tool with Node.js
description: A TypeScript CLI ready to publish to npm: commands with Commander, bundled with tsup, tests with Vitest and `npx` support from day one.

verify.command: {{pm}} run typecheck && {{pm}} run test && {{pm}} run build && node dist/index.js hello Ada

instructions:
## How to work here

- One file per command in `src/commands/` once there is more than one; `src/index.ts` only wires them into Commander.
- Keep logic in pure functions (like `src/greet.ts`) and test them with Vitest; commands only parse arguments and print.
- Errors: throw with a clear message; `src/index.ts` prints it in red and exits with code 1. Never print stack traces to users.
- Respect `NO_COLOR` and keep stdout for output that other programs might pipe; progress and logs go to stderr.
- Try it with `npm run dev -- hello Ada`. Publish with `npm publish` (it builds first).
- Before finishing: `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`.
